Page 37, line 9, after the dollar amount, in-

sert ‘‘(increased by $13,000,000)’’. 


AMENDMENT NO. 26 OFFERED BY MR . PERRY

business is the demand for a recorded 
vote on amendment No. 26, printed in 
House Report 119–232, offered by the 
gentleman from Pennsylvania (Mr. 
P
ERRY), on which further proceedings 
were postponed and on which the ayes 
prevailed by voice vote. 
The Clerk will redesignate the 
amendment.

ment. 
RECORDED VOTE

has been demanded. 
A recorded vote was ordered. 
The Acting CHAIR. This is a 2- 
minute vote. 
The vote was taken by electronic de-
